predeploys.name: ConsensusSystemCall420
predeploys.notes: Runtime bytecode is placed at 0x043c. Gateway trusts only go-ethereum params.SystemAddress; ValidatorRegistry and RewardController bind their consensus-system caller to 0x043c.

rules: Runtime bytecode, not creation bytecode, is written to genesis alloc.code.
Constructor effects must be represented explicitly in genesis storage because constructors do not execute for direct predeploy placement.
Every predeploy must have a compiled runtime code hash and storage root manifest before launch.
Address collisions or missing artifacts are fatal.
Genesis generator must never infer storage layouts from source text.
ConsensusSystemCall420 MUST be present at 0x043c before ValidatorRegistry or RewardController consensus writes can succeed.
